real-estate.outlook: East Midlands Freeport Toton Hub emerging as the region's transformational development. Nottingham Island Quarter delivering Phase 1 with Phases 2-4 following. Derby City Centre West masterplan in development. Northampton and Corby growth programmes active. East Midlands Investment Zone sites being prepared.

energy.outlook: Ratcliffe-on-Soar Energy Park — UK's last coal plant site now being masterplanned for green hydrogen, BESS, and data centres. STEP Fusion (West Burton C) the most significant long-term energy project. Rolls-Royce Derby SMR programme progressing. NG-ED RIIO-ED2 East Midlands £1.5bn active.

rail.outlook: Midland Main Line Phase 2 electrification remains the significant unfunded gap. HS2 Toton site development linked to EM Freeport. Chesterfield Staveley HS2 infrastructure progressing. Network Rail Eastern CP7 programme covering East Midlands active. East Midlands Rail Hub business case progressing.

utilities.outlook: Severn Trent and Anglian Water both delivering significant AMP8 programmes in the region. Trent Catchment Flood Programme active. Hinckley NRFI drainage and utilities infrastructure in development. East Midlands water quality investment driven by Ofwat PR24.

highways.outlook: A46 Newark Bypass in delivery — strategic link improving East-West connectivity. Grantham Southern Relief Road in procurement. Lincoln Eastern Bypass progressing. A1 Peterborough to Blyth missing links under National Highways review for RIS3.
